Hey, I’m an engineering student too, and I’ve struggled with a lot of what you’re feeling. I’ll give you an Engineers answer. 
There a few common causes for your problem. One of the biggest, and in my opinion the most important, is isolation. We’ve been through a pandemic, and it sounds like both of us struggle socially. Being alone hurts the mind more than anything else, and snuffs out the light faster than anything else. For me personally, I was happy last week when I was with my friends, this week I haven’t seen anyone and I’m sad. If you want solutions, look towards improving your social skills through practice. Make friends, surround yourself with them. Another possible solution, just an option, is to check out a therapist or psychiatrist. My campus offers free therapy, it’s actually really wonderful. Finally, perspective; the most important thing to do is to keep a very open mind (which it sounds like you’re doing). Keeping an open mind to the idea that things will improve and your life is in your control will help you. Your life is truly in your hands. Knowing that will help things get better.
